result.summary: Found 3 visual issues: a persistent loading spinner overlaying a restaurant image, inconsistent favorite button styling between cards, and a truncated restaurant name in the horizontally-scrolled list.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner is rendered directly on top of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar hero image in the 'Popular right now' section, obscuring the food photo and suggesting an unfinished or failed image load.
issues.suggestion: Remove the spinner once the image has loaded, or show a placeholder/background color and retry loading if the image fails; ensure loading states do not persist over final content.

issues.description: The favorite heart icon styling is inconsistent between the two 'Popular right now' cards: the ramen card uses a plain outline heart, while the pizza card uses a heart inside a dark circular button.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button component so the same background shape, size, and icon style is used across all restaurant cards.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal list shows a truncated name, 'Trattoria Piccol...', at the right edge of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the card width and text truncation are intentional, or add peek padding to the scroll container so users can see the card continues off-screen; consider revealing the full name on tap or using a consistent truncation strategy.
